title: Implement installed launchers with automatic PackageRoot resolution
goal: Launch the RID-native installed Host and Companion from a canonical receipted layout without caller-supplied PackageRoot.
acceptanceCriteria: Root-level launchers derive the distribution root and PackageRoot only from their own canonical location.
The launcher selects the RID-native self-contained executable and preserves explicit four-root Host invocation.
A complete verified layout remains runnable after relocation while partial or tampered relocation and mismatched overrides fail closed.
Hostile working directories and parent configuration do not influence authority selection.
risks: Path-based authority discovery could accept an attacker-controlled sibling.
Launcher generation could break deterministic archives.
decisions: Derive PackageRoot from launcher location and verify layout before use.
Self-contained launch removes only Host-owned dotnet requirements; Module-declared prerequisites remain authoritative.
Execution completed locally on the native current RID without Target release or remote changes.
